Pre-existing failure, not caused by #22
======================================

Host: same local macOS machine used for #22 evidence, 2026-11-12.
Base worktree: d61b2fa (no #22 changes), created with `git worktree add`.

  go test -count=1 ./...
  --- FAIL: TestConcurrentGuardsCannotSpendLastSlotTwice (0.02s)
  --- FAIL: TestConcurrentAgentsReserveSharedPromotionOnce (0.02s)
  FAIL github.com/canhta/threadwalker/internal/guard

The same tests pass when the guard package runs alone:

  go test -count=1 ./internal/guard/ -run TestConcurrentAgentsReserveSharedPromotionOnce -v
  --- PASS (0.02s)

With the #22 worktree:

  go test -count=1 ./...        -> FAIL internal/guard (same two tests)
  go test -count=1 -p 1 ./...   -> PASS all packages

The failure is a SQLite write-contention race in the guard tests under a loaded
host. It reproduces on the unmodified base commit, so it is not introduced by the
agent-browser adapter. It is recorded here rather than hidden or "fixed" by
weakening a guard test.

Fix and verification (#23)
=========================

The concurrency tests now open one independent store handle per goroutine on the
same temporary database. Each handle is limited to one connection and sets
`PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000` before any goroutine starts. The tests keep their
existing concurrency, reservation and effect-count assertions; no production
guard or store code changed.

  go test -count=100 -run \
    'TestConcurrentGuardsCannotSpendLastSlotTwice|TestConcurrentAgentsReserveSharedPromotionOnce' \
    ./internal/guard/
  ok github.com/canhta/threadwalker/internal/guard 39.234s

Under eight busy-loop CPU loaders:

  go test -count=30 -run \
    'TestConcurrentGuardsCannotSpendLastSlotTwice|TestConcurrentAgentsReserveSharedPromotionOnce' \
    ./internal/guard/
  ok github.com/canhta/threadwalker/internal/guard 6.810s

Three consecutive exact checks:

  go vet ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
  ok github.com/canhta/threadwalker/internal/guard (1.664s, 2.129s, 2.298s)
